meta.title: *Most Requested* Self-Planned VIETNAM Itinerary 🇻🇳 Flights, Visa, Day Tours, Budget & more! Kashika
meta.description:
Planning a trip to Vietnam? In this video, I’m sharing our self-planned 11-day Vietnam itinerary – without the help of a travel agent! 🇻🇳✈️ We explored it all on our own, managing hotels, flights, local transportation, and experiences. If you’re looking for a Vietnam travel guide, budget tips, itinerary ideas, and must-visit places, this video will help you plan your trip smoothly.
📌 Whether you’re a solo traveler, couple, or group, this DIY itinerary will help you enjoy Vietnam like a local.
Don’t forget to like, share, and subscribe for more self-planned travel itineraries and tips! 🌍✨

Vietnam Itinerary Timestamp:
Introduction: 00:00 - 00:51

Ho Chi Minh: 02:34 - 13:24
Da Nang: 13:25 - 23:51
Hanoi: 23:52 - 29:47
Phu Quoc: 29:48 - 36:28
